verses.en: And when king Arad the Canaanite, which dwelt in the south, heard tell that Israel came by the way of the spies; then he fought against Israel, and took some of them prisoners.
verses.pt: Ora, ouvindo o cananeu, rei de Arade, que habitava no Negebe, que Israel vinha pelo caminho de Atarim, pelejou contra Israel, e levou dele alguns prisioneiros.
verses.en_web: The Canaanite, the king of Arad, who lived in the South, heard that Israel came by the way of Atharim. He fought against Israel, and took some of them captive.
verses.en_bbe: And it came to the ears of the Canaanite, the king of Arad, living in the South, that Israel was coming by the way of Atharim, and he came out against them and took some of them prisoners.

verses.en: And Israel vowed a vow unto the LORD, and said, If thou wilt indeed deliver this people into my hand, then I will utterly destroy their cities.
verses.pt: Então Israel fez um voto ao Senhor, dizendo: Se na verdade entregares este povo nas minhas mãos, destruirei totalmente as suas cidades.
verses.en_web: Israel vowed a vow to Yahweh, and said, “If you will indeed deliver this people into my hand, then I will utterly destroy their cities.”
verses.en_bbe: Then Israel made an oath to the Lord, and said, If you will give up this people into my hands, then I will send complete destruction on all their towns.

verses.en: And the LORD hearkened to the voice of Israel, and delivered up the Canaanites; and they utterly destroyed them and their cities: and he called the name of the place Hormah.
verses.pt: O Senhor, pois, ouviu a voz de Israel, e entregou-lhe os cananeus; e os israelitas os destruíram totalmente, a eles e às suas cidades; e chamou-se aquele lugar Horma.
verses.en_web: Yahweh listened to the voice of Israel, and delivered up the Canaanites; and they utterly destroyed them and their cities. The name of the place was called Hormah.
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord, in answer to the voice of Israel, gave the Canaanites up to them; and they put them and their towns completely to destruction: and that place was named Hormah.

verses.en: And they journeyed from mount Hor by the way of the Red sea, to compass the land of Edom: and the soul of the people was much discouraged because of the way.
verses.pt: Então partiram do monte Hor, pelo caminho que vai ao Mar Vermelho, para rodearem a terra de Edom; e a alma do povo impacientou-se por causa do caminho.
verses.en_web: They traveled from Mount Hor by the way to the Red Sea, to go around the land of Edom The soul of the people was very discouraged because of the journey.
verses.en_bbe: Then they went on from Mount Hor by the way to the Red Sea, going round the land of Edom: and the spirit of the people was overcome with weariness on the way.

verses.en: And the people spake against God, and against Moses, Wherefore have ye brought us up out of Egypt to die in the wilderness? for there is no bread, neither is there any water; and our soul loatheth this light bread.
verses.pt: E o povo falou contra Deus e contra Moisés: Por que nos fizestes subir do Egito, para morrermos no deserto? pois aqui não há pão e não há água: e a nossa alma tem fastio deste miserável pão.
verses.en_web: The people spoke against God, and against Moses, “Why have you brought us up out of Egypt to die in the wilderness? For there is no bread, and there is no water; and our soul loathes this disgusting bread.”
verses.en_bbe: And crying out against God and against Moses, they said, Why have you taken us out of Egypt to come to our death in the waste land? For there is no bread and no water, and this poor bread is disgusting to us.

verses.en: And the LORD sent fiery serpents among the people, and they bit the people; and much people of Israel died.
verses.pt: Então o Senhor mandou entre o povo serpentes abrasadoras, que o mordiam; e morreu muita gente em Israel.
verses.en_web: Yahweh sent venomous snakes among the people, and they bit the people. Many people of Israel died.
verses.en_bbe: Then the Lord sent poison-snakes among the people; and their bites were a cause of death to numbers of the people of Israel.

verses.en: Therefore the people came to Moses, and said, We have sinned, for we have spoken against the LORD, and against thee; pray unto the LORD, that he take away the serpents from us. And Moses prayed for the people.
verses.pt: Pelo que o povo veio a Moisés, e disse: Pecamos, porquanto temos falado contra o Senhor e contra ti; ora ao Senhor para que tire de nós estas serpentes. Moisés, pois, orou pelo povo.
verses.en_web: The people came to Moses, and said, “We have sinned, because we have spoken against Yahweh, and against you. Pray to Yahweh, that he take away the serpents from us.” Moses prayed for the people.
verses.en_bbe: Then the people came to Moses and said, We have done wrong in crying out against the Lord and against you: make prayer to the Lord to take away the snakes from us. So Moses made prayer for the people.

verses.en: And the LORD said unto Moses, Make thee a fiery serpent, and set it upon a pole: and it shall come to pass, that every one that is bitten, when he looketh upon it, shall live.
verses.pt: Então disse o Senhor a Moisés: Faze uma serpente de bronze, e põe-na sobre uma haste; e será que todo mordido que olhar para ela viverá.
verses.en_web: Yahweh said to Moses, “Make a venomous snake, and set it on a pole. It shall happen, that everyone who is bitten, when he sees it, shall live.”
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord said to Moses, Make an image of a snake and put it on a rod, and anyone who has been wounded by the snakes, looking on it will be made well.

verses.en: And Moses made a serpent of brass, and put it upon a pole, and it came to pass, that if a serpent had bitten any man, when he beheld the serpent of brass, he lived.
verses.pt: Fez, pois, Moisés uma serpente de bronze, e pô-la sobre uma haste; e sucedia que, tendo uma serpente mordido a alguém, quando esse olhava para a serpente de bronze, vivia.
verses.en_web: Moses made a serpent of brass, and set it on the pole. If a serpent had bitten any man, when he looked at the serpent of brass, he lived.
verses.en_bbe: So Moses made a snake of brass and put it on a rod; and anyone who had a snakebite, after looking on the snake of brass, was made well.

verses.en: And the children of Israel set forward, and pitched in Oboth.
verses.pt: Partiram, então, os filhos de Israel, e acamparam-se em Obote.
verses.en_web: The children of Israel traveled, and encamped in Oboth.
verses.en_bbe: Then the children of Israel went on and put up their tents in Oboth.

verses.en: And they journeyed from Oboth, and pitched at Ije-abarim, in the wilderness which is before Moab, toward the sunrising.
verses.pt: Depois partiram de Obote, e acamparam-se em Ije-Abarim, no deserto que está defronte de Moabe, para o nascente.
verses.en_web: They traveled from Oboth, and encamped at Iyeabarim, in the wilderness which is before Moab, toward the sunrise.
verses.en_bbe: And journeying on again from Oboth, they put up their tents in Iye-abarim, in the waste land before Moab looking east.

verses.en: From thence they removed, and pitched in the valley of Zared.
verses.pt: Dali partiram, e acamparam-se no vale de Zerede.
verses.en_web: From there they traveled, and encamped in the valley of Zered.
verses.en_bbe: And moving on from there, they put up their tents in the valley of Zered.

verses.en: From thence they removed, and pitched on the other side of Arnon, which is in the wilderness that cometh out of the coasts of the Amorites: for Arnon is the border of Moab, between Moab and the Amorites.
verses.pt: E, partindo dali, acamparam-se além do Arnom, que está no deserto e sai dos termos dos amorreus; porque o Arnom é o termo de Moabe, entre Moabe e os amorreus.
verses.en_web: From there they traveled, and encamped on the other side of the Arnon, which is in the wilderness, that comes out of the border of the Amorites: for the Arnon is the border of Moab, between Moab and the Amorites.
verses.en_bbe: From there they went on and put up their tents on the other side of the Arnon, which is on the waste land at the edge of the land of the Amorites; for the Arnon is the line of division between Moab and the Amorites:

verses.en: Wherefore it is said in the book of the wars of the LORD, What he did in the Red sea, and in the brooks of Arnon,
verses.pt: Pelo que se diz no livro das guerras do Senhor: Vaebe em Sufa, e os vales do Arnom,
verses.en_web: Therefore it is said in the book of the Wars of Yahweh, “Vaheb in Suphah, the valleys of the Arnon,
verses.en_bbe: As it says in the book of the Wars of the Lord, Vaheb in Suphah, and the valley of the Amon;

verses.en: And at the stream of the brooks that goeth down to the dwelling of Ar, and lieth upon the border of Moab.
verses.pt: e o declive dos vales, que se inclina para a situação Ar, e se encosta aos termos de Moabe
verses.en_web: the slope of the valleys that incline toward the dwelling of Ar, leans on the border of Moab.”
verses.en_bbe: The slope of the valleys going down to the tents of Ar and touching the edge of Moab.

verses.en: And from thence they went to Beer: that is the well whereof the LORD spake unto Moses, Gather the people together, and I will give them water.
verses.pt: Dali vieram a Beer; esse é o poço do qual o Senhor disse a Moisés: Ajunta o povo, e lhe darei água.
verses.en_web: From there they traveled to Beer; that is the well of which Yahweh said to Moses, “Gather the people together, and I will give them water.”
verses.en_bbe: From there they went on to Beer, the water-spring of which the Lord said to Moses, Make the people come together and I will give them water.

verses.en: Then Israel sang this song, Spring up, O well; sing ye unto it:
verses.pt: Então Israel cantou este cântico: Brota, ó poço! E vós, entoai-lhe cânticos!
verses.en_web: Then Israel sang this song: “Spring up, well! Sing to it,
verses.en_bbe: Then Israel gave voice to this song: Come up, O water-spring, let us make a song to it:

verses.en: The princes digged the well, the nobles of the people digged it, by the direction of the lawgiver, with their staves. And from the wilderness they went to Mattanah:
verses.pt: Ao poço que os príncipes cavaram, que os nobres do povo escavaram com o bastão, e com os seus bordões. Do deserto vieram a Matana;
verses.en_web: the well, which the princes dug, which the nobles of the people dug, with the scepter, and with their poles.” From the wilderness they traveled to Mattanah;
verses.en_bbe: The fountain made by the chiefs, made deep by the great ones of the people, with the law-givers' rod, and with their sticks. Then from the waste land they went on to Mattanah:

verses.en: And from Mattanah to Nahaliel: and from Nahaliel to Bamoth:
verses.pt: de Matana a Naaliel; de Naaliel a Bamote;
verses.en_web: and from Mattanah to Nahaliel; and from Nahaliel to Bamoth;
verses.en_bbe: And from Mattanah to Nahaliel: and from Nahaliel to Bamoth:

verses.en: And from Bamoth in the valley, that is in the country of Moab, to the top of Pisgah, which looketh toward Jeshimon.
verses.pt: e de Bamote ao vale que está no campo de Moabe, ao cume de Pisga, que dá para o deserto.
verses.en_web: and from Bamoth to the valley that is in the field of Moab, to the top of Pisgah, which looks down on the desert.
verses.en_bbe: And from Bamoth to the valley in the open country of Moab, and to the top of Pisgah looking over Jeshimon.

verses.en: And Israel sent messengers unto Sihon king of the Amorites, saying,
verses.pt: Então Israel mandou mensageiros a Siom, rei dos amorreus, a dizer-lhe:
verses.en_web: Israel sent messengers to Sihon king of the Amorites, saying,
verses.en_bbe: And Israel sent men to Sihon, king of the Amorites, saying,

verses.en: Let me pass through thy land: we will not turn into the fields, or into the vineyards; we will not drink of the waters of the well: but we will go along by the king’s high way, until we be past thy borders.
verses.pt: Deixa-me passar pela tua terra; não nos desviaremos para os campos nem para as vinhas; as águas dos poços não beberemos; iremos pela estrada real até que tenhamos passado os teus termos.
verses.en_web: “Let me pass through your land. We will not turn away into field or vineyard. We will not drink of the water of the wells. We will go by the king’s highway, until we have passed your border.”
verses.en_bbe: Let me go through your land: we will not go into field or vine-garden, or take the water of the springs; we will go by the highway till we have gone past the limits of your land.

verses.en: And Sihon would not suffer Israel to pass through his border: but Sihon gathered all his people together, and went out against Israel into the wilderness: and he came to Jahaz, and fought against Israel.
verses.pt: Siom, porém, não deixou Israel passar pelos seus termos; pelo contrário, ajuntou todo o seu povo, saiu ao encontro de Israel no deserto e, vindo a Jaza, pelejou contra ele.
verses.en_web: Sihon would not allow Israel to pass through his border, but Sihon gathered all his people together, and went out against Israel into the wilderness, and came to Jahaz. He fought against Israel.
verses.en_bbe: And Sihon would not let Israel go through his land; but got all his people together and went out against Israel into the waste land, as far as Jahaz, to make war on Israel.

verses.en: And Israel smote him with the edge of the sword, and possessed his land from Arnon unto Jabbok, even unto the children of Ammon: for the border of the children of Ammon was strong.
verses.pt: Mas Israel o feriu ao fio da espada, e apoderou-se da sua terra, desde o Arnom até o Jaboque, até os amonitas; porquanto a fronteira dos amonitas era fortificada.
verses.en_web: Israel struck him with the edge of the sword, and possessed his land from the Arnon to the Jabbok, even to the children of Ammon; for the border of the children of Ammon was strong.
verses.en_bbe: But Israel overcame him, and took all his land from the Arnon to the Jabbok, as far as the country of the children of Ammon, for the country of the children of Ammon was strongly armed.

verses.en: And Israel took all these cities: and Israel dwelt in all the cities of the Amorites, in Heshbon, and in all the villages thereof.
verses.pt: Assim Israel tomou todas as cidades dos amorreus e habitou nelas, em Hesbom e em todas as suas aldeias.
verses.en_web: Israel took all these cities. Israel lived in all the cities of the Amorites, in Heshbon, and in all its villages.
verses.en_bbe: And Israel took all their towns, living in Heshbon and all the towns and small places of the Amorites.

verses.en: For Heshbon was the city of Sihon the king of the Amorites, who had fought against the former king of Moab, and taken all his land out of his hand, even unto Arnon.
verses.pt: Porque Hesbom era a cidade de Siom, rei dos amorreus, que pelejara contra o precedente rei de Moabe, e tomara da mão dele toda a sua terra até o Arnom.
verses.en_web: For Heshbon was the city of Sihon the king of the Amorites, who had fought against the former king of Moab, and taken all his land out of his hand, even to the Arnon.
verses.en_bbe: For Heshbon was the town of Sihon, king of the Amorites, who had made war against an earlier king of Moab and taken from him all his land as far as the Arnon.

verses.en: Wherefore they that speak in proverbs say, Come into Heshbon, let the city of Sihon be built and prepared:
verses.pt: Pelo que dizem os que falam por provérbios: Vinde a Hesbom! edifique-se e estabeleça-se a cidade de Siom!
verses.en_web: Therefore those who speak in proverbs say, “Come to Heshbon. Let the city of Sihon be built and established;
verses.en_bbe: So the makers of wise sayings say, Come to Heshbon, building up the town of Sihon and making it strong:

verses.en: For there is a fire gone out of Heshbon, a flame from the city of Sihon: it hath consumed Ar of Moab, and the lords of the high places of Arnon.
verses.pt: Porque fogo saiu de Hesbom, e uma chama da cidade de Siom; e devorou a Ar de Moabe, aos senhores dos altos do Arnom.
verses.en_web: for a fire has gone out of Heshbon, a flame from the city of Sihon. It has devoured Ar of Moab, The lords of the high places of the Arnon.
verses.en_bbe: For a fire has gone out of Heshbon, a flame from the town of Sihon: for the destruction of Ar in Moab, and the lords of the high places of the Arnon.

verses.en: Woe to thee, Moab! thou art undone, O people of Chemosh: he hath given his sons that escaped, and his daughters, into captivity unto Sihon king of the Amorites.
verses.pt: Ai de ti, Moabe! perdido estás, povo de Quemós! Entregou seus filhos como fugitivos, e suas filhas como cativas, a Siom, rei dos amorreus.
verses.en_web: Woe to you, Moab! You are undone, people of Chemosh! He has given his sons as fugitives, and his daughters into captivity, to Sihon king of the Amorites.
verses.en_bbe: Sorrow is yours, O Moab! Destruction is your fate, O people of Chemosh: his sons have gone in flight, and his daughters are prisoners, in the hands of Sihon, king of the Amorites.

verses.en: We have shot at them; Heshbon is perished even unto Dibon, and we have laid them waste even unto Nophah, which reacheth unto Medeba.
verses.pt: Nós os asseteamos; Hesbom está destruída até Dibom, e os assolamos até Nofá, que se estende até Medeba.
verses.en_web: We have shot at them. Heshbon has perished even to Dibon. We have laid waste even to Nophah, Which reaches to Medeba.”
verses.en_bbe: They are wounded with our arrows; destruction has come on Heshbon, even to Dibon; and we have made the land waste as far as Nophah, stretching out to Medeba.

verses.en: Thus Israel dwelt in the land of the Amorites.
verses.pt: Assim habitou Israel na terra dos amorreus.
verses.en_web: Thus Israel lived in the land of the Amorites.
verses.en_bbe: So Israel put up their tents in the land of the Amorites.

verses.en: And Moses sent to spy out Jaazer, and they took the villages thereof, and drove out the Amorites that were there.
verses.pt: Depois Moisés mandou espiar a Jazer, e tomaram as suas aldeias e expulsaram os amorreus que ali estavam.
verses.en_web: Moses sent to spy out Jazer. They took its villages, and drove out the Amorites who were there.
verses.en_bbe: And Moses sent men secretly to Jazer, and they took its towns, driving out the Amorites who were living there.

verses.en: And they turned and went up by the way of Bashan: and Og the king of Bashan went out against them, he, and all his people, to the battle at Edrei.
verses.pt: Então viraram-se, e subiram pelo caminho de Basã. E Ogue, rei de Basã, saiu-lhes ao encontro, ele e todo o seu povo, para lhes dar batalha em Edrei.
verses.en_web: They turned and went up by the way of Bashan. Og the king of Bashan went out against them, he and all his people, to battle at Edrei.
verses.en_bbe: Then turning they went up by the way of Bashan; and Og, king of Bashan, went out against them with all his people, to the fight at Edrei.

verses.en: And the LORD said unto Moses, Fear him not: for I have delivered him into thy hand, and all his people, and his land; and thou shalt do to him as thou didst unto Sihon king of the Amorites, which dwelt at Heshbon.
verses.pt: Disse, pois, o Senhor a Moisés: Não o temas, porque eu to entreguei na mão, a ele, a todo o seu povo, e à sua terra; e far-lhe-ás como fizeste a Siom, rei dos amorreus, que habitava em Hesbom.
verses.en_web: Yahweh said to Moses, “Don’t fear him, for I have delivered him into your hand, with all his people, and his land. You shall do to him as you did to Sihon king of the Amorites, who lived at Heshbon.”
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord said to Moses, Have no fear of him: for I have given him up into your hands, with all his people and his land; do to him as you did to Sihon, king of the Amorites, at Heshbon.

verses.en: So they smote him, and his sons, and all his people, until there was none left him alive: and they possessed his land.
verses.pt: Assim o feriram, a ele e seus filhos, e a todo o seu povo, até que nenhum lhe ficou restando; também se apoderaram da terra dele.
verses.en_web: So they struck him, with his sons and all his people, until there were no survivors; and they possessed his land.
verses.en_bbe: So they overcame him and his sons and his people, driving them all out: and they took his land for their heritage.
